sources.title: 靠視覺AI打入小鵬，歐特明營運審慎樂觀
sources.effective_period: Around 2021; article refers to then-current revenue and cumulative first-ten-month results.
sources.locator: Article text on customer concentration: “小鵬則佔營收逾8成”.
sources.note: Secondary financial-news reporting; revenue share is reported, but the precise accounting interval for the greater-than-80% figure is not specified in the retrieved text.

sources.title: 萬寶周刊報導:ADAS系統領導廠商 歐特明
sources.effective_period: Historical period discussed in the article; it forecasts XPeng's revenue share declining after 2023.
sources.locator: Article passage stating XPeng was oToBrite's largest customer and its revenue share exceeded 80%.
sources.note: The page is hosted on oToBrite's website but identifies itself as a Wanbao Weekly report; treat the claim as secondary reporting, not an audited issuer disclosure.

sources.title: 歐特明電子股份有限公司
sources.locator: Product description listing “Level 2+ ADAS視覺AI感知系統oToDAS600”; the same profile separately describes XPeng supply.
sources.note: Industry-association listing supports the existence of a Level 2+ vision-AI product, but does not say XPeng used that product.

sources.title: oToBrite to Showcase its Latest Vision-AI Technology Realizing Level 2+ ADAS Functions for Large Commercial Vehicles at IAA Transportation 2024
sources.locator: Article text describing oToGuard's vision-AI technology and Level 2+ ADAS functions.
sources.note: Taiwan News republishes a PR Newswire release; the stated application is large commercial vehicles, not XPeng passenger vehicles.

sources.title: 歐特明登錄興櫃
sources.effective_period: At the time of the company's emerging-stock listing; approximately 2021.
sources.locator: Company announcement says oToBrite was a main supplier of panoramic and automatic-parking perception systems for XPeng mass-production models, and separately says it was developing Level 2+ ADAS with Honhua.
sources.note: Official issuer material supports the XPeng product relationship and a separate Level 2+ development relationship, but does not state that XPeng received the Level 2+ system.

sources.title: 民國112年度年報
sources.effective_period: Historical product development beginning in 2015; technologies in mass production by 2021.
sources.locator: Annual-report passages beginning “本公司自2015年接獲納智捷及小鵬汽車量產案開始” and describing mass-produced visual-AI technologies through 2021.
sources.note: Official annual report supports XPeng production programs and visual-AI/ADAS technology, but does not identify XPeng as the recipient of an L2+ ADAS product.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

原始短句未給定時間範圍；最大客戶的證據是歷史性二手報導，不應外推為目前排名。
營收占比逾八成的報導未清楚界定精確會計區間；不能據此補出精確年度或正式申報口徑。
Level 2+視覺AI ADAS能力有產品資料支持，但資料所述產品或合作對象並未與小鵬汽車建立明確連結。
